annotations.title: Severance Pay by Weeks of Service

description: Work out severance pay from a formula you send: weeks of pay per year of service, an optional minimum number of weeks and an optional cap in weeks. Send the years of service, the weeks per year, the weekly pay and, if the plan has them, the minimum and the cap. Choose whether a part year counts in proportion or only completed years count. Get back the weeks of severance, which limit (minimum or cap) was applied if any, the amount, and the arithmetic written out step by step. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/severance-weeks). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

cap_weeks.description: Optional: the most weeks the plan pays.

label.description: Optional label for the calculation (your own text, echoed back; not a person's name).

minimum_weeks.description: Optional: the fewest weeks the plan pays, whatever the service.

partial_years.description: prorate (default): a part year counts in proportion. completed_years_only: only whole completed years count (6.99 counts as 6).

weekly_pay.description: Pay for one week, in the currency you use (the plan's definition of a week's pay: you work it out and send it).

weeks_per_year.description: Weeks of pay for each year of service under the plan or agreement (2 = two weeks per year).

years_of_service.description: Years of service, up to 2 decimals (6.5 = six and a half years).

name: severance_weeks
